transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

For nearly two years now, I've been struggling with severe mood swings where I feel extremely energetic and high. At the same time, I've been having really strange thoughts and hearing and seeing things that aren't actually there.
Do you experience these hallucinations and strange thoughts only when your mood is very high or very low, or do they also persist during periods when your mood is relatively stable?

Yes, they actually do happen even when my mood is completely stable. There have been times, lasting about two weeks or sometimes longer, where I was still hearing those voices and having those beliefs even though I wasn't feeling super energetic or irritable.

latest_inference.note: Previously, the candidates were Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features and Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type). Because the patient reports that psychotic symptoms persist for at least two weeks in the absence of mood episodes, Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features is ruled out, as that diagnosis requires psychotic symptoms to occur exclusively during mood episodes. Therefore, Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type) remains the primary candidate.
